description: This Java source file defines the class PcbMergeTool, which provides functionality for merging and manipulating PCB design data in a project. It includes methods for reading, merging, and transforming PCB nodes, handling network mappings, and performing various PCB modification operations based on change requests, such as copying, optimizing, adding, and moving PCB components.

classes.name: PcbMergeTool
classes.description: Main class handling PCB merging operations, including reading PCB files, merging components, handling network IDs, and applying change requests for PCB modifications.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the tool, processes command-line arguments, and executes PCB change requests such as copying, optimizing, adding, and moving components.

methods.name: findModuleByName
methods.description: Finds a module node within a PCB node structure by its reference name.

methods.name: mergePcb
methods.description: Merges source PCB node data into the destination PCB node, handling nets, zones, arcs, lines, labels, modules, segments, and vias, with proper net ID and name mappings.

methods.name: removeNodes
methods.description: Removes modules from a PCB node that meet removal criteria based on reference names.

methods.name: shouldRemove
methods.description: Determines if a module node should be removed based on reference text and change requests.

methods.name: fixNetId
methods.description: Updates net IDs and global names within a node to reflect merged and updated network mappings.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the standard output.
